description: MOTION GRAPHICS and ANIMATED VIDEO in one call: kinetic typography (animated text), a logo animation or intro, a product launch film, an animated social cut. MOVING PICTURES are the default for launch, product and social: in each scene with a picture, one thing physically happens (a seed splits open, an eye opens, the view travels through a forest), filmed by an image-to-video model, with the type, transitions and the music's beat put on top; a few minutes, priced per shot, and with no pictures given each scene paints its own. moving:false, and always for type and logo, makes it in code with no video model: type, pictures and drawn graphics filmed by a moving virtual camera, a 1080p MP4 in about a minute, billed for its compute only. Pick it for 'animated video', 'motion graphics', 'kinetic text', 'text animation', 'logo animation', 'logo intro', 'animated explainer' asks. recipe: 'type' (every line its own animated card, no picture needed), 'logo' (the logo assembles out of dots and settles, the name and tagline land under it), 'launch' (30s 16:9), 'product' (15s), 'social' (15s 9:16). Or `spec`, the whole film as JSON (help:true returns the language). STEPS: without confirm it is a FREE quote that gives both prices (length, the music's tempo; the spec in structuredContent): say both; preview:true is a 1-credit contact sheet of the still version; confirm:true renders. You may write `moves` yourself, or the film's own planner writes them for a few credits. Only the user's or the brand's words appear: never invent a claim, number or review. projectUrl = a past film's url returns its saved spec to edit and render again.

brief.description: what the film is about, for the planner

confirm.description: true renders the film for real credits; without it you get a free quote

energy.description: how much the film keeps moving, 0 to 1; 0 films exactly what is written

help.description: true returns the spec language and recipes; renders nothing

images.description: pictures, hero first (https, upload_file URL or Library id)

logo.description: logo image: https, upload_file URL or Library id; default the brand's

model.description: image-to-video model id from hermoso_capabilities; default is the best value for short shots

moves.description: per scene, what happens in its picture; omit and the planner writes them

action.description: the one thing that physically happens, in plain words

layer.description: the picture layer's id, when the scene has several

matchNext.description: the shot ends on the next scene's picture

still.description: a picture to animate, when not the one in the scene

stillPrompt.description: a picture to paint first, for a scene with none

video.description: a shot already filmed: kept, and not paid for again

moving.description: true: one thing physically happens in each picture, filmed by a video model. false: stills moved by a virtual camera, far cheaper. Default true for launch, product, social

preview.description: true renders a 1-credit contact sheet to approve before the full render

projectUrl.description: a past film's url; returns its saved spec to edit and render again

recipe.description: type, logo, launch, product or social; help:true lists the recipes

resolution.description: the moving shots: 720p or 1080p (default) where the model has them

spec.description: the whole film as JSON, from a quote or a saved film; help:true shows the spec language

tagline.description: line shown under the headline or logo

theme.description: logo: dark for a light logo

name: make_motion_film
title: Make a motion graphics video
